# CCL on real decisions: one US mortgage lender, HMDA 2018-2023 (auto-generated by report.py)

Lender: U.S. Bank National Association (public LEI 6BYL5QZYBDK8S7L73M02); conventional, first-lien, owner-occupied home-purchase applications, originated vs denied.
Statute = the written Qualified Mortgage DTI cap (approve iff DTI <= 43%). Yearly replay: mine on t-3..t-2, admit on t-1, test on t.
Race / ethnicity / sex / age are never mined; they are used only for the disparate-impact audit. HMDA has no outcomes and no credit scores.

## Admitted law (power-aware miner), its 'because' (denial reasons) and the fairness audit

audit ratio = lowest / highest group rate of the holding's benefit (loosen) or burden (tighten); < 0.8 fails the four-fifths rule.

| test year | kind | holding | support | replay precision | because (top denial reasons) | race ratio | sex ratio |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2021 | loosen | `aus != 'TOTAL' AND disc <= 49  => APPROVE` | 11193 | 0.881 | - | 0.874 | 0.944 |
| 2021 | tighten | `jumbo AND ltv > 90 AND disc > 25  => REJECT` | 104 | 0.965 | {'collateral': 0.663, 'debt-to-income': 0.145, 'other': 0.084} | **0.615** | **0.455** |
| 2022 | loosen | `aus != 'TOTAL' AND disc <= 49  => APPROVE` | 11241 | 0.907 | - | 0.86 | 0.922 |
| 2022 | tighten | `jumbo AND ltv > 90 AND disc > 15  => REJECT` | 184 | 0.963 | {'collateral': 0.752, 'debt-to-income': 0.152, 'credit history': 0.048} | **0.538** | **0.6** |
| 2022 | tighten | `score_model = '8' AND disc > 15  => REJECT` | 59 | 0.952 | {'credit history': 0.36, 'debt-to-income': 0.266, 'other': 0.209} | **0.074** | **0.429** |
| 2023 | loosen | `aus != 'TOTAL' AND disc <= 49  => APPROVE` | 10935 | 0.897 | - | 0.885 | 0.905 |

Reading notes: `disc` is the DTI variable (named so the miner runs unchanged). `aus` = automated underwriting system (TOTAL = FHA scorecard). `score_model = '8'` = 'other credit scoring model'.
Caveats: one lender; DTI is bucketed below 36% and above 49%; no credit score or outcome in HMDA, so most within-policy denials (credit history) are invisible to any miner; the base rate is high (always-approve ~0.91).
